rationale: The agent properly verified the user by matching full name and zip to a single account before sharing order details. It looked up both orders, correctly identified the tablet order (#W7895761), and accurately provided the Chicago shipping address, the tracking number, and the delivered status (i.e., not in transit). It correctly reported the tablet’s storage (64GB) from the order details. For changing the default address, the agent clearly stated the intended change, obtained explicit confirmation, executed the update with the correct user_id, and confirmed the result. No unsupported claims, no actions on the wrong account, and no writes without confirmation. The casual chat was handled appropriately and did not violate policy.
